data.raw_text:
I know how some things sound so incredulous that it's hard to believe them.

Here's the list of my near-death experiences:

Nearly Losing Your Right Foot
Volcanic Eruption
Typhoon
Dysentery
Combined Philippines Event (Volcano + Typhoon + Dysentery)
Inside a Tornado
Severe Fall
C. difficile Infection
Multiple Assaults (Military, Off-Base, Abusive Ex)
Nearly Being Run Over by My Abusive Ex
Nearly a Half Dozen Times She Held a Knife Against Me
Self-Harm Thoughts
Motor Vehicle Accident
Fires
Tornado (separate)
Despair
Military Incident

The rarity of all 17 of these events occurring to just one person is astronomical.

I choose to live EVERY day.

I am blessed. I am unique. I am 1 in trillions upon trillions.

Guess what... If I survived all this, you can survive what you've been through. You just cannot ever give up. Keep moving forward. And don't ever stop.
